baselinePassRecords.name: fixed-baseline
baselinePassRecords.checkpoint: Original WORK A full refresh_database+init_game, fixed23Dohna+Chunhyang

limits: Actual installed FastQSP, normal refresh_database + init_game initialization and copied current WORK JSON constants; generation/helper source was not altered.
Each batch has 50 newly randomized background actors; predefined-description actors selected from the random pool are excluded from that count and separately recorded.
Primary stat bounds are 0..5 after generation, with the existing peerless beauty=6 behavior preserved.
All 11 new IDs are structurally reachable through the source helper and its 14,429 legal age/world/family/occupation triples; not every new ID must occur in 300 random draws.
No actual user save file was loaded or edited; native diagnostic save files were used only for comparison and will be removed.
The early large single-run diagnostics exceeded the 60-second runner bound; the final proof uses six successful bounded batches.

A four-bootstrap diagnostic stalled after fixed generation; an independent baseline four-bootstrap random check passed, so this is not asserted as a source defect. The final proof uses normal full new-game initialization.

The first and second 50-sample diagnostics initially timed out without a FAIL message. Scoped UIAutomation found no accessible error window. Their subsequent runs completed; the exact timeout cause was not established and is not attributed to source behavior.
